AI and ML engineering

media.alt: AI and ML engineering hero ribbon

data.description: We build RAG systems, predictive models, AI-powered assistants, and inference services engineered to spec and build real business value. Each one is tuned to your domain and measured on a number the business already watches. The repeatable analysis moves to the system, and your team spends its time where judgment is actually needed.

data.heading: Engineered for domain, tuned for impact

blocks.title: AI strategy and architecture
bullets: Model, data and serving choices mapped to the outcome they move
A sequenced build plan with the first release named up front
Architecture chosen on fit to the domain
Success measured on a business number agreed before engineering begins

blocks.title: Model customization and fine-tuning
bullets: Fine-tuning and adaptation on enterprise-specific data
Domain benchmarks agreed and tested against before release
Accuracy held steady well past launch
Retraining pipelines that keep the system current as data shifts

blocks.title: RAG and decision intelligence
bullets: Retrieval grounded in current, trusted enterprise sources
Reasoning steps recorded and open to audit
Knowledge graphs connecting entities across functions
Proprietary context used with IP held inside a secure enclave

blocks.title: AI-powered assistants
bullets: Support, voice and document workloads served continuously
Quality attributes scored automatically on every interaction
Root cause analysis carried inside the pipeline itself
Multilingual systems standing up across regions from a single build

blocks.title: Inference services and enterprise integration
bullets: Native integration with enterprise data, identity and services
Inference engineered for sustained production load
Text, voice and document workloads on one architecture
Accuracy monitored so it holds as volume climbs

blocks.title: Legacy code understanding and rebuild
bullets: Legacy business logic read and narrated for engineering review
Domain-specific code conversion automated across large codebases
Specialist attention spent on validating the result
Multi-year rewrite programs compressed to a fraction of the original plan

blocks.title: Fix the target
blocks.body: The business number comes first, with the workload, the volume and the tolerance for error named alongside it.

blocks.title: Ground it in your domain
blocks.body: Data, retrieval and evaluation benchmarks are built from the enterprise sources your people already trust.

blocks.title: Engineer against the domain
blocks.body: The system is tuned on your data and checked against domain benchmarks before it goes live.

blocks.title: Tune in production
blocks.body: Drift is monitored and retraining runs on a pipeline, so accuracy holds as a sustained property while the system runs.
